sloka: प्रागुदक्प्रवणां वेदिं विशालां दीप्तपावकाम्।ददर्श भरतस्तत्र पुण्यां रामनिवेशने ॥ २.९९.२४॥
transliteration: prāgudakpravaṇāṁ vediṁ viśālāṁ dīptapāvakām।dadarśa bharatastatra puṇyāṁ rāmaniveśane ॥ 2.99.24॥

translations.english: Bharata beheld at Rama's residence a sacred and spacious altar sloping to the northeast, with a burning fire upon it.
